units.source_text: 发长彦脱下银盔，尊敬的向大臣鞠了一个躬，说道：

en.t: Hatsunagahiko took off his silver helmet, bowed respectfully to the minister, and said:

units.source_text: “我是住在大和国葛城山山脚下的樵夫发长彦，

en.t: I am Hatsunagahiko, a woodcutter who lives at the foot of Mount Katsuragi in Yamato Province.

units.source_text: 是我亲手救下了您的两位公主。

en.t: I saved your two princesses with my own hands.

units.source_text: 您面前这两位武士，在杀死食蜃人和土蜘蛛的事上，

en.t: As for these two warriors before you, in the matter of killing the mirage-eater and the earth spider,
they did not contribute the slightest effort.
